senses.label: 苦難・患難
senses.def: 迫害・窮乏・困難など、人が外から受ける圧迫や苦しみ。信じる者が耐え忍ぶ苦難として最も多く現れる。
senses.def_en: Pressure or suffering that a person receives from outside, such as persecution, want, or hardship. The most frequent use, as affliction that believers endure.

senses.label: 終末の大患難
senses.label_en: the great tribulation of the end times
senses.def: 終わりの日に先立つ、前例のない大きな苦難。「大いなる患難」と呼ばれる用例。
senses.def_en: The unprecedented great affliction that comes before the last days; a use called the "great tribulation".

senses.label: 心身の苦痛・悲痛
senses.label_en: pain / distress of body and mind
senses.def: 産みの苦しみや心の締めつけなど、人の内側で感じられる痛みや悲しみ。
senses.def_en: Pain and sorrow felt within a person, such as labor pains or an anguished heart.
